resolution: Fixed the symmetry badge reporting '110 off' on a model that looked nearly symmetric. Two causes: (1) symmetryReport measured about the bbox CENTRE on the axis, which drifts away from the true mirror plane as soon as the model is even slightly asymmetric and then mis-flags every vertex pair — switched it to measure about the ORIGIN (c=0), the same plane mirror/symmetrize operate on, and replaced exact-position key matching with an eps-tolerance spatial grid so accumulated float noise from edits no longer false-flags symmetric verts; (2) the badge defaulted to the X axis, but a car is symmetric left/right and NOT front/back, so X correctly-but-uselessly reported almost everything off — the Studio badge now auto-picks the axis the model is most symmetric about when no mirror plane is enabled (and uses the enabled plane when one is), and the symmetrize keep-+/keep-- buttons follow that same axis. Verified: editMesh suite 65/65 (a Z-symmetric/X-asymmetric box reports correctly per-axis; sub-eps float noise reads symmetric), full hmsc-int cart bundles clean. Committed 030de680e.
